text:
sara: starting a quick thread to coordinate a docs PR that adds guidance for CPU/quantized fallbacks in the model catalog. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1310 :wave:

ben: skimmed. two asks: 1) add a small perf table for 'polaris13b -> polaris-lite-quant' fallback, 2) include an SDK example for setting `fallback_model` with error handling.

sara: adding both. preliminary bench (local quick run) shows throughput ~-25% and tail latency +12ms, but i'll attach full CSVs. marking numbers as experimental.

kai: please include a short note about vocabulary/tokenizer differences for quant variants (truncation can differ). also mention that some quant builds change average token length.

harry: spotted a broken internal doc link: the catalog's fallback paragraph points at /model-catalog#fallbacks but our header is `#fallback-playbook`. i'll file a tiny patch after the PR merges, or we can update the link in this PR.

link-bot: reference: runtime compatibility matrix: https://docs.redwood.ai/model-catalog#compatibility-matrix

ci-bot: docs CI: link-checker passed, markdown-lint failed (line-length in two files).

sara: i'll wrap lines and shorten long examples. also will add a reproducible bench command and upload bench_{date}.csv.

ben: bench command to include in PR (one-liner):
```bash
python -m tools/bench --model polaris13b --fallback polaris-lite-quant --seq 2048 --runs 6 --out bench_polaris_fallback.csv
```
Add p50/p90/p99 columns to the table.

kai: SDK snippet suggestion (add try/except example):
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
rc = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_KEY'])
try:
    out = rc.generate(model='polaris13b', prompt='...', fallback_model='polaris-lite-quant', max_tokens=256)
except Exception as e:
    # fallback may also raise if tokenization mismatch -> surface a clear error
    print('primary failed, check logs', e)
else:
    print(out.text)
```
Short note: "fallback_model is attempted for runtime errors/OOMs only; it does not switch tokenizers automatically. Validate stop sequences and token counts when migrating."

harry: please add a one-line operational blurb: "If you see a spike in fallback rates, check capacity and autoscale thresholds; transient spikes can cause short-lived OOMs."

sara: added that and pushed a patch. checklist for reviewers in PR description: attach bench CSVs, add compatibility row, update SDK sample, verify links/anchors, and run docs CI. tagging @ben, @kai, @harry. :pray:

ben: i'll run the bench later today and paste raw numbers back here.

kai: left two micro-nits in the PR about wording around tokenization; otherwise LGTM.

harry: will open small link-fix PR if we keep the existing header name; otherwise approve once benches are attached.

sara: aiming to merge during tomorrow's docs merge window. i'll add [release-note] and request a quick docs+devex approval. :rocket:

ci-bot: new commit pushed, running docs CI... all checks passing.

sara: thanks all, will merge after one more bench upload and a squash.

ben: uploaded bench_polaris_fallback.csv (attached to PR). p50: 78ms, p90: 142ms, p99: 320ms, throughput drop ~24%.

kai: numbers look sane. approving now. :+1:

harry: approved as well, merging after window opens.

sara: merged. follow-up: will run a quick link-sweep to catch any stale anchors and open follow-ups if needed. :white_check_mark:
